twin_reference_cases.name: fuboTV (pre-Hulu standalone)
twin_reference_cases.distinguishing_fact: A perennially cash-burning vMVPD that survived by a transformational scale combination rather than by organic profitability — the pattern of rescue-by-merger.

twin_reference_cases.name: Roku
twin_reference_cases.distinguishing_fact: A US streaming-platform name that de-rated hard on slowing growth and margin doubts, then re-rated as advertising monetization improved.

twin_reference_cases.name: Chicken Soup for the Soul Entertainment (Redbox)
twin_reference_cases.distinguishing_fact: A streaming/media roll-up that levered into an acquisition while burning cash and hit a maturity/liquidity wall before the synergy story could pay off.

twin_reference_cases.name: Paramount Skydance
twin_reference_cases.distinguishing_fact: A legacy-media name carrying heavy losses and content-cost pressure that survived via a combination reshaping its scale and economics.

twin_reference_cases.name: Quibi
twin_reference_cases.distinguishing_fact: A subscription-video venture that could not stem subscriber attrition and consumed its cash before reaching self-sustaining scale.

decisive_question.question: Will the pro-forma adjusted-EBITDA ramp (TTM $100M toward a $300M-by-2028 target) convert into actual positive free cash flow before the declining cash balance and the 2027/2029 maturities force dilutive or distressed financing?

evidence_for.claim: TTM pro forma adjusted EBITDA has already crossed $100M and management reaffirmed at least $300M by 2028 plus positive FCF in 2027/2028, with a contractual Hulu wholesale-fee step-up (95% in 2026 scaling to 99% by 2028) cited as visibility.
